description: Last night I got invited back to Nexus for the monthly meeting (alumni privileges), I sat in on a fireside chat with Rob Carter that felt less like a “tech talk” and more like a leadership gut-check. Not the usual AI buzzwords. Not the “robots are coming” panic. More like: how do we lead when the world is changing fast and changing again tomorrow? And if you’re me and running for office in Arkansas House District 35, that’s not a foreign thought. That’s right-now. That’s jobs. That’s schools. Th
title: From a Fireside Chat to Front Porches in District 35: What Rob Carter’s AI Talk Made Crystal Clear for Our Campaign
